OpenOnCreate.Name: Replace the default "Create Actor" for characters
OpenOnCreate.Hint: When a player creates a new Character actor, open the creation wizard instead of a blank sheet.

IncludeHomebrew.Name: Include homebrew content
IncludeHomebrew.Hint: Also offer ancestries, cultures, paths and talents from world items and other modules' compendiums (always on for the "Other" setting).

MaxAttribute.Name: Maximum attribute score at creation
MaxAttribute.Hint: No attribute may go above this value at level 1.

CultureCount.Name: Cultures at creation
CultureCount.Hint: How many cultures (cultural expertises) a new character takes.

GoalCount.Name: Goals at creation
GoalCount.Hint: How many goals a new character starts with.

MinConnections.Name: Minimum connections at creation
MinConnections.Hint: The wizard warns if a character has fewer connections than this.

ExtraExpertises.Name: Additional expertises
ExtraExpertises.Hint: "int" to grant expertises equal to Intellect, or a fixed number.

EraRules.Name: Era rules
EraRules.Label: Edit Era Rules
EraRules.Hint: Which Scadrial eras each path, specialty, ancestry, culture or talent belongs to.

Notify.NoSystem: Character Creation Beautifier does not support this game system yet.
Notify.Failed: Character creation failed. See the console (F12) for details.
Notify.Blocked: Fix the errors marked in red before continuing.
